caption: The video captures a wide, fixed view of a sunset sky, where a deep teal-green upper atmosphere is streaked with clouds lit orange-pink by a low sun glowing near the left-center horizon. Dark silhouetted rooftops and treetops line the bottom edge and stay fixed in place. The cloud formations drift and subtly deform across the frame. The elongated pink mass near the upper center shifts its shape, while the banded clouds on the right creep slowly leftward, indicating gentle wind motion rather than camera movement. A small dark bird with spread wings is present in the upper right in the first visible frame and has exited by the next. Occasional tiny specks appear briefly near the center and on the right before vanishing. The sun's bright glow and the overall color balance remain essentially constant, the dark cloud bank over the sun shifting only marginally as the slow drift continues across the excerpt.
relations: Gentle wind causes the banded clouds on the right to creep slowly leftward and deform.
The small dark bird in the upper right flies out of the frame shortly after the first visible moment.
The sun's bright glow remains constant while the dark cloud bank over it shifts only marginally.
Occasional tiny specks appear briefly near the center and right before vanishing.
